items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: But he had two cousins, that lived there also. They were two girls, and one was named Carolyn and the youngest was named Lupe.

ctx.x: But he had two cousins, that lived there also. They were two girls, and one was named Carolyn and the youngest was named Lupe. They were mixed with French and Spanish.
